notes: Deterministic execution does not imply task authorization.
Any mutation still requires task authorization, scope admission and a current fence.
repo_heartbeat_federation_reconciliation may write only the admitted central coverage receipt namespace and grants no cross-repository mutation authority.

healer_sovereign_scheduling executes only fixed repository-local handlers declared in StegVerse-Healer source against already materialized repositories; arbitrary commands and GitHub credential transport are not admitted.
formal_mathematical_candidate_generation is restricted to bounded candidate/receipt generation and grants no canonical mathematical standing or cross-repository formalism mutation.
Agent capability describes what the executor can do, not what it is authorized to do for a task.
Deployment authority must be separately admitted by the HANDOFF and deployment control plane.
Observer profiles cannot be selected for mutation or deployment capabilities.
This profile may only execute under an admitted sovereign-runtime HANDOFF and current heartbeat fence.
Third-party provider availability never grants authority or satisfies sovereign activation.
Mutation is limited to the admitted sovereign-runtime receipt namespace unless a separate deployment authority is present.

canonical_artifact_validation is validation-only execution against already-materialized local artifacts and grants no repository checkout, credential, provider, wallet, route, or deployment authority.

master_records_replay_reconstruction_validation is limited to exact local custody/replay/reconstruction proof under the task's bounded receipt namespace and may not create Master Records action authority.
stegfin_live_entry_inventory_observation is read-only chain inventory plus bounded receipt persistence and grants no provider or wallet authority.
stegfin_sovereign_internal_trading_activation is limited to the zero-external-cost internal activation round and grants no external trade, wallet, custody or scale-up authority.
orphan_lifecycle_reconstruction is continuity-only eligibility for a generated orphan-recovery handoff; it cannot execute the recovered parent task or revive an ended claim/fence.

stegnutrition_machine_continuation is limited to locally materialized StegNutrition observation, fixed no-network validation, continuation projection and receipts; it grants no GitHub fetch/write, general code-generation, credential, deployment or release authority.
This profile exists only for engine-v11 generated repository-resolution work.

It may observe an already-authorized sovereign-node declaration and write bounded resolution receipts, but it may not manufacture node ownership, credentials, provider capability, wallet authority, deployment authority, or hosted fallback.
Failure to observe an eligible declaration must escalate through the existing resolution hierarchy rather than becoming passive BLOCKED state.
Public research execution is limited to an admitted source queue and bounded local receipt/workspace namespace.
The profile grants no GitHub repository checkout/write, credential, publication, research-promotion, provider, wallet, trade, heartbeat-state, claim, or fence authority.
Authenticated sources require a separate TV/TVC authority path and are not admitted by this profile.
